notes.title: July 4th----------"Bang!" final update
notes.content:
This version is the final update for the "Bang!" major version. 
"Bang!" update content: 

Armored Vehicle: 

1. Armored Vehicle Ramming Head (1.5X ramming damage) (0.4.5) 

2. Armored Vehicleruster (1.5X maximum speed) (0.4.5) 

3. Automatic Repair Device (Automatic repair device that adjusts repair speed according to extent of damage) (0.4.5) 

4. Shield Generator (Grants players a shield) (0.5.0) 



Monsters: 

1. Replicating Monsters (Monsters that can be attacked with remote means or have special abilities) 

① Common Laser Type: Emits a laser that vehicles at a moderate frequency 

② Common Light Ball Type: Emits a light ball that attacks vehicles at a moderate frequency 

③ Ultra-Fast Light Ball Type Emits a light ball that attacks vehicles at a high frequency 

④ Healing Type: Heals surrounding enemies at a moderate frequency 

⑤ Chaotic Type: Em a large light ball that attacks vehicles at a low frequency, and occasionally generates a shield to protect itself 

*Current version of the above monsters can only be produced by monster n 

2. Monster Nest 

A nest with extremely high health, almost no attack power, and unable to move, which produces all the above replicating monsters 



Player: 

1. Added a magazine indicator to let players know the progress of reloading 

2. Fixed some known bugs 

3. New Catalogue function (04.5): Players can find information about monsters, weapons, game play, game operations, etc. in the catalogue 



Story Mode: 

1. Added hidden elements some levels 

2. Added a monster nest in level 10 



Achievements: 

1. Eliminate the Root: Clear the monster nest Story Mode level 10 

2. Come Prepared: Collect all hidden elements in the level and drive an armored vehicle that has been upgraded three times in level 



*This announcement generally records all the updates of this version; if there are any problems, please leave a message in the game's comment section. 
Have fun!

notes.title: Slash & Destroy! —————— Major Update
notes.content:
Main Updates
Combat:
1. Laser Weapon Reinforcement: 
two main laser weapons have damage critical values, allowing lasers to clear small monsters more quickly
   Specifically: The common laser sweep will instantly kill enemies with less than 4 health             
                      The death ray sweep will instantly kill enemies with less than 10 health

2. Gas Bomb Launcher Repair: The flames left behind by the gas bomb explosion have sound effects

3. New Mode: Character Mode
   (1) Battle Style:
            Horizontal and vertical movement is achieved through WASD, without the need to the character's direction
            The character can sprint to increase movement speed, and cannot turn while sprinting

   (2) New Character Weapons:
            Shot: Lower damage, shorter range, can only be used by the character and not by the turret
            Submachine Gun: Extremely low damage, extremely fast rate of fire smaller spread, can only be used by the character and not by the turret
            Light Saber: A melee weapon hidden in the map, with extremely high and percentage damage, and grants an invincible effect during a sprint after obtaining it

   (3) New Character Items:
            Grenade:rown by the character, will explode after a delay, causing high damage
            Flash Bang: Thrown by the character, explodes after a delay, causes extremely low damage andorients enemies

   (4) Map Items:
            Supply boxes will be available in the map, containing a large amount of supplies such as medicine, grenades etc.

   (5) Monster Movement Style:
            Monsters no longer explode but are knocked back after touching the character, and the character will take damage
            Some monsters will idle instead of constantly tracking the player when the player is not discovered
            Add a portion of monsters exclusive to character mode

4 New Level Addition: Five new levels
   Crisis (Character Mode)
   Variation·Two (Turret Mode)
   Sprint·Two (Armored Car Mode)
   Crisis·Two (Character Mode)
   To the death (Armored Car Mode)

Gameplay:
1. Price Display: The in the game have price displays
   Specifically: Weapons, supplies, etc. have clear price displays under the purchase button

2. Sound Effect Addition: New effects have been added for level completion

3. Translation Fix: The bug where the first level had no Chinese display in the menu has been fixed

4 New Start Page: Some of the buttons and images on the start page have been adjusted, and the main menu now displays the name of the major version

[]5. New Achievements Added:
   (1) "Rest in Pieces!": Inflict damage on at least 12 enemies with a grenade                                                   
   (2 "Hasta la vista, Baby!": Defeat the BOSS in the tenth level
   (3) "May the Force Be With You": Obtain a light saber
   (4) SMITE V: Defeat a certain number of enemies with the light saber
   (5) Peace Dove: Complete a character mode level without killing a enemy
   (6) Indiana Jones: Kill the Glitter Monster
   (7) Cardinal's Treasure: Earn a total of 14 000 000 currency
   (8) Le Comte de Monte-Cristo: Earn a total of 100 000 000 currency

Have fun playing!

notes.title: December 25 - Upgrades and Props 语气调整
notes.content:
Upgrade
Electric Field
* Covers around the turret 
* Causes electric damage to enemies 
* Stuns enemies for period of time 
* Cost: 1000 

Side Turret (Sturdy Turret) 
* Built on the main turret 
* Automatically targets fires at enemies 
* Tracks bullets 
* Increases health limit to 40 
* Cost: 1500 

Props
 Tool 
* Restores 5 health points after a 1-second delay upon use 
* Cooldown after use is a waiting period (1 second) 
* Cost 100 

Lightning Strike 
* Immediately summons lightning at the mouse pointer upon use 
* Deals extremely high damage 
* Cost: 200

Other Updates 
[strike]Added many unknown bugs[/strike] 
* Fixed the bug in the last version's save feature 
* Fixed bug where monster generation did not increase with difficulty 
* Increased the number of monsters spawned 
* Changed the generation probabilities of some monsters 
* Increased starting money (500)

语气调整

notes.title: December 2nd Update:Weapon Upgrade
notes.content:
Updated the AIM ADSORPTION (No more missing shots!!!) 

Updated 8 NEW weapons, upgraded from the four basic weapons: 
Machine Gun  → Piercing Machine Gun: Ultra-fast firing speed and reload speed 
                       → Shotgun: Area attack ———————————————————————————————————————————————————— 
Flamethrower → Flame Storm: Larger attack range, stronger damage 
                       → Incendiary Grenade Launcher: Fires incendiary grenades  ———————————————————————————————————————————————————— 
Cannon           → Missile Launcher: Fires missiles that track the mouse pointer 
                       → Mine Launcher: Fires mines land at the mouse pointer ————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Laser Gun       → Death Ray: Higher damage and faster damage increase (the bad news is less ammo 
                       → Tractor Laser: Creates a light circle at the mouse pointer that attracts enemies ————————————————————————————————————————————————————
